campaign_prompts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create an original premium fitness website hero photograph, panoramic 2.22:1 aspect ratio. A generic adult athletic male fitness model around 35 years old, with natural believable muscular build, short dark hair, subtle stubble, wearing a plain black sleeveless training top, performing a controlled single dumbbell curl, gaze focused down toward the dumbbell. Waist-up composition, model and fully visible dumbbell entirely in the RIGHT 55 percent; LEFT 45 percent is very dark midnight charcoal negative space for website text. Dark softly blurred gym background, cinematic directional studio key light, restrained lime green edge accent, crisp skin and clothing detail, premium athletic campaign photography, rich contrast with readable shadow detail. Anatomically correct hands and equipment, confident not aggressive. No text, numbers, lettering, badges, logos, UI, watermark or graphic layout. Original anonymous model, not the gym owner or any reference person. Clean sophisticated black and lime palette.

High quality photographic cutout integrated in graphic lime backdrop.
